resolution.note: backlog triage 2026-11-07: Improves retired delivery ceremony (briefs/review/verify/slice/deliver/worker/red-first/hardening checklist)

title: Run every ship verifier in deliver dry-run
body: Outcome: krn deliver --dry-run (and preflight where possible) runs every verifier krn ship runs, including the PR title rule (Conventional, ends with a task id); a dry-run on a PR whose title lacks the task id exits non-zero. Evidence: PR #161 deliver dry-run exit 0, then the real ship refused "PR title must be Conventional and end with a task id" after CI and the gate (deliver-1.out kept only exit=76; use --json to keep receiver stderr). .krn/runs/delivery-loop/session-continuity/review-verdict-cleanup/.
